name: Remembrance Palm
description: Strike with a palm that recalls the weakest spot in this foe's frame from every earlier meeting.

name: Remembrance Cover
description: Throw up the cover that held best in the user's memory of similar blows.

name: Remembrance Glance
description: Glance at a scene and keep it exact for as long as it is needed.

name: Remembrance Prompt
description: Prompt an ally with the first line of a drilled response and let the ally's memory finish it.

name: Remembrance Cleansing
description: Cleanse the false memories that a curse laid over an ally and let the true ones surface.

name: Remembrance Haze
description: Spread a haze of half-memory over the foes so each recalls a slightly different fight.

name: Remembrance Spear
description: Drive a spear of the foe's own remembered fear through the barrier of the mind.

name: Remembrance Ward
description: Hold the user's remembrance so clear that a probe or a false memory finds no seam to enter by.

name: Memory Unmaking
description: Unmake one chosen memory in the foe's mind without a mark on the body.

name: Mindkeep Elbow
description: Drive an elbow at the spot the mind marked in the first exchange.

name: Mindkeep Hold
description: Hold the mind and body to one remembered stance until the blow has spent itself.

name: Mindkeep Count
description: Keep a silent count of every person and every move in the field.

name: Mindkeep Tread
description: Tread the path the mind drew beforehand without a glance at the ground.

name: Mindkeep Drill
description: Run an ally through a drill in the user's own mind so the ally's body knows it.

name: Mindkeep Mending
description: Mend the mind of an ally that a probe has torn by setting its lost parts back from the user's own record.

name: Mindkeep Break
description: Break a probing technique mid-reach by shutting the door of memory in its face.

name: Mindkeep Lance
description: Throw a lance of kept memory through the foe's mental guard in a single line.

name: Mindkeep Seal
description: Seal a foe's recall of a technique so the foe cannot summon it for a time.

name: Mindkeep Mirror
description: Hold a mirror of kept memory before the mind so a probe is turned and read in the prober's own head.

name: Annal Blow
description: Hit with the blow that the annal records as winning the last exchange.

name: Annal Brace
description: Take the brace that the annal records as holding against a blow like this one.

name: Annal Survey
description: Survey the field and write each fact of it into the mind's annal in order.

name: Annal Glide
description: Glide along a line the annal says is free of traps.

name: Annal Whisper
description: Whisper an entry from the annal that tells an ally just what was done the last time.

name: Annal Replay
description: Replay a page of the annal at will to examine a moment of the fight from outside it.

name: Annal Restoring
description: Restore a mind with a missing stretch of days by copying the user's page of those days into it.

name: Annal Veil
description: Draw a veil of blank pages over the foe's memory of where the user's side stands.

name: Annal Pierce
description: Pierce the foe's mind with a single line read out of the foe's own forgotten history.

name: Annal Screen
description: Hold a screen of unaltered pages before the mind so no rewrite can take hold.

name: Struck Hour
description: Strike one hour from the foe's record of the fight so the foe cannot recall how the foe came to stand where the foe stands.

name: Unforgetting Jab
description: Jab at the exact place a past jab once found its mark.

name: Unforgetting Screen
description: Draw a screen of remembered guards that give the first blow nowhere to land.

name: Unforgetting Eye
description: Rest the eye on a thing once and never lose it again.

name: Unforgetting Gait
description: Hold a gait learned in youth and find it whole in the middle of the fight.

name: Unforgetting Cue
description: Give an ally a cue that never fades from the ally's mind however long the fight runs.

name: Unforgotten Cleansing
description: Cleanse the confusion of lost time from an ally by laying a clear record of that time over it.

name: Unforgotten Veil
description: Cast a veil of unforgotten scenes over the foe so the foe cannot tell present from past.

name: Unforgotten Replay
description: Replay a scene unforgotten to read every face in it at once.

name: Unforgotten Counter
description: Counter a move by naming it in the mind and striking where its last wielder fell.

name: Unforgotten Spear
description: Hurl a spear of every unforgotten slight at the foe's guard of mind.

name: Unforgotten Ward
description: Hold a ward of unforgotten truth that false pictures cannot cross.

name: Sky Unforgotten
description: Let the whole remembered weight of the open sky fall on the foes in a single descent.

name: Temper Palm
description: Strike with a palm tempered by the memory of broken pledges.

name: Temper Cover
description: Cover the body with the memory of a pledge kept under fire.

name: Temper Gauge
description: Gauge how sound a person's word is by the memory of what that person has kept.

name: Temper Stride
description: Stride along a line tempered by long practice and cross it without a stumble.

name: Temper Reminder
description: Remind a comrade of the vow the comrade made and put steel into the comrade's stance.

name: Troth Mending
description: Mend the damage a coerced pledge did to an ally's mind and free the ally of its hold.

name: Troth Haze
description: Cloud a foe's memory of what the foe has sworn so the foe's loyalties waver for a time.

name: Troth Spear
description: Spear the oath-breaker with the memory of the oath broken.

name: Troth Seal
description: Seal a foe's recall of the words of a pledge so the foe cannot invoke it.

name: Sworn Erasure
description: Erase from the pledge-breaker the knowledge of the pledge so that the breaker's conscience has nothing left to hold.

name: Etched Fist
description: Throw a fist along a line etched into the muscle by a thousand repeats.

name: Etched Guard
description: Take a guard so deeply etched that it is up before the thought of it.

name: Etched Reading
description: Read the etchings that storms and blows have left on a body and a place.

name: Etched Prompt
description: Prompt an ally to recall the etching of a hard-won lesson and act on it.

name: Etched Mending
description: Smooth over a scar of the mind left by a storm of events without erasing the lesson in it.

name: Etched Blur
description: Blur the etching of a foe's training for a few breaths so the foe's form falls apart.

name: Etched Lance
description: Cut a lance-line into the foe's mind along the grain of its own deepest memory.

name: Etched Ward
description: Hold the etched record of the self so deeply that no tool can scrape it.

name: Deep Etching
description: Draw a deep etching out of the user's own mind and cut it into the foe's so the foe lives the user's worst day.

name: Zephyr Palm
description: Hit with a palm that rides the remembered wind of the best blow ever thrown.

name: Zephyr Cover
description: Cover the body with a breath of remembered wind that takes the sting off a hit.

name: Zephyr Survey
description: Survey the field as the wind did on its last crossing and read the marks it carried.

name: Zephyr Tread
description: Tread so lightly on a remembered route that the wind seems to carry the user.

name: Zephyr Cue
description: Send a cue on the wind to an ally across the field so the ally acts at the right moment.

name: Zephyr Replay
description: Replay the past hour on the wind to see who walked where.

name: Zephyr Cleansing
description: Blow a stale curse of forgetting out of an ally's mind with a long clean breath.

name: Zephyr Haze
description: Stir a haze of dust-like memory round the foe that hides the user's position.

name: Zephyr Breaker
description: Break a foe's technique with a gust of conflicting memory in the middle of its form.

name: Zephyr Spear
description: Throw a spear of remembered gale through the mental guard of the foe.

name: Zephyr Ward
description: Hold a ward in which the wind of the past blows away any false picture laid on the mind.

name: Zephyr Seal
description: Seal the foe's recall of the user's last three moves so the foe must guess them afresh.

name: Zephyr Unmaking
description: Blow a whole chain of the foe's recent memory away on the wind and strike at the gap that remains.

name: Fealty Palm
description: Strike with a palm that remembers every comrade it has fought beside.

name: Fealty Cover
description: Cover a comrade with the user's body and the memory of what was sworn.

name: Fealty Count
description: Count the sworn present and note who of them is missing from their place.

name: Fealty Tread
description: Tread the same paces in the same order as every comrade who walked this drill.

name: Fealty Prompt
description: Prompt a comrade with the sworn word and see the comrade's stance firm.

name: Fealty Mending
description: Mend the grief that has begun to eat at a comrade's memory of the fallen.

name: Fealty Haze
description: Cloud a captured foe's memory of the way to the sworn company's camp.

name: Fealty Spear
description: Pierce the foe's mind with the unbroken memory of a company that has never run.

name: Fealty Ward
description: Hold a ward in which the shared memory of the sworn cannot be overwritten.

name: Engraved Vow
description: Engrave the vow into the minds of all sworn so that no force can make them forget it and seal it away from foes.
